items.action: 写 tweet，强调“机器验证几乎通过、数学界尚未正式接受”，别写成已经获奖。
items.body: HN 主帖 2,583 分/1,784 评 → 2,844 分/2,016 评；Masullo 的全人类证明声称第二帖 1,978 分/914 评 → 2,347 分/1,131 评；新增 Lean 官方博客核查帖 627 分/487 评。维基百科“Riemann hypothesis”昨日第 6，295,157 次浏览；“Levent Alpöge”词条第 11，124,632 次浏览。AP、BBC 11 月 21 日跟进。仍待完成 comparator 运行；克雷研究所仍将该问题列为未解。

en.action: Write a tweet stressing 'machine verification has almost fully passed, but the math community has not formally accepted it yet' — do not present it as a prize already won.
en.body: The main Hacker News thread rose from 2,583 points / 1,784 comments to 2,844 / 2,016; Masullo's all-human proof claim, the second thread, went from 1,978 / 914 to 2,347 / 1,131; a new Lean community blog post on the verification drew 627 points / 487 comments. On Wikipedia, 'Riemann hypothesis' was yesterday's No. 6 most-read page with 295,157 views, and 'Levent Alpöge' ranked No. 11 with 124,632 views. AP and the BBC followed up on November 21. The comparator run is still pending, and the Clay Institute still lists the problem as unsolved.
en.title: Riemann Hypothesis proof claim: HN main thread at 2,844 points, Wikipedia entry drew 295,157 views in a day, one check still pending

items.action: 写 tweet，可结合 Anthropic IPO 次日回落与“AI 泡沫”争论；投资判断不在雷达范围内。
items.body: 纳指周跌 10%，为 2020 年 3 月以来最差一周；标普 500 跌 8.6%、道指跌 8%，双双进入技术性回调（较近期高点跌 10% 以上）；费城半导体指数周跌 17.1%，为 2001 年以来最差。英伟达周跌 23%（周五单日跌 14%），为 2008 年以来最差一周；Anthropic 上市次日跌 9.2% 至 88.30 美元，逼近 83 美元发行价（首日开盘 111.50、收 97.17 美元）。纳指成分股一周蒸发市值超 4 万亿美元。

en.action: A tweet could tie Anthropic's second-day slide to the wider 'AI bubble' debate; investment judgment is outside this radar's scope.
en.body: The Nasdaq fell 10% for the week, its worst week since March 2020; the S&P 500 dropped 8.6% and the Dow 8%, both entering a technical correction (down more than 10% from recent highs); the PHLX Semiconductor Index fell 17.1% for the week, its worst since 2001. Nvidia lost 23% for the week (down 14% on Friday alone), its worst week since 2008; Anthropic fell 9.2% on its second day to $88.30, closing in on its $83 IPO price (it opened at $111.50 on day one and closed at $97.17). Nasdaq-listed companies shed more than $4 trillion in market value over the week.
en.title: US AI trade unwinds sharply: Nasdaq down 10% in a week, its worst since March 2020

items.action: 仅记录；做 agent 能力评估的人可读 METR 原文，别把 40 小时当成“能独立工作一周”。
items.body: METR 11 月 20 日发布 Time Horizons 2.0：前沿模型 50% 成功率对应的任务时长，GPT-6 Astra 约 40 小时、Claude Opus 5.5 约 39 小时；任务时长每约 3.6 个月翻倍。需注意：95% 置信区间极宽（Astra 13–2,645 小时），仅 9% 的人类基线是实测；按趋势外推 2027 年 7 月达 200 小时，但 METR 提示那不是预测；开放式研究判断任务上模型仍明显落后。

en.action: Just record it; people working on agent capability evaluation can read METR's original, and should not read 40 hours as 'able to work alone for a week'.
en.body: METR released Time Horizons 2.0 on November 20: the task length at which frontier models succeed 50% of the time is about 40 hours for GPT-6 Astra and about 39 hours for Claude Opus 5.5, with task length doubling roughly every 3.6 months. Caveats: the 95% confidence intervals are extremely wide (13–2,645 hours for Astra), only 9% of the human baselines are measured rather than estimated, and the trend extrapolates to 200 hours by July 2027 — which METR warns is not a forecast; on open-ended research-judgment tasks, models still lag well behind.
en.title: METR Time Horizons 2.0: GPT-6 Astra at about 40 hours, Opus 5.5 at about 39 hours

ja.action: 記録のみ。エージェントの能力評価に携わる人はMETRの原文を読むとよい。40時間を「1週間ひとりで働ける」と受け取らないこと。
ja.body: METRは11月20日、Time Horizons 2.0を発表した。フロンティアモデルが50%の成功率でこなせるタスクの長さは、GPT-6 Astraが約40時間、Claude Opus 5.5が約39時間で、タスクの長さは約3.6か月ごとに倍増している。ただし注意点がある。95%信頼区間はきわめて広く（Astraは13～2,645時間）、人間のベースラインのうち実測は9%のみ。トレンドを外挿すると2027年7月に200時間に達するが、METRはそれが予測ではないと警告している。オープンエンドな研究判断タスクでは、モデルは依然として大きく遅れている。
ja.title: METR Time Horizons 2.0：GPT-6 Astraは約40時間、Opus 5.5は約39時間

items.title: METR 时间跨度 2.0：GPT-6 Astra 约 40 小时、Opus 5.5 约 39 小时
